verdict.rationale: Factory explicitly documents tiered autonomy for droid exec, letting leads control which operations run without manual confirmation (factory-docs-7), alongside related governance features like readiness reports and diff review before merge. However, evidence lacks detail on how granular tiers are configured, whether they're settable org-wide/per-role, or how they apply outside droid exec (e.g., interactive CLI/App sessions). Missing for 10: configuration UI/schema for tiers, scope of tiers across all product surfaces, independent/hands-on confirmation of tier enforcement.
